properties.name: What the graph computes reaches the quality axis it informs
properties.statement: Where reflow2 computes something that bears on a quality axis, it shall report that evidence against the axis by name, and shall say plainly of each axis whether a design graph can inform it at all — never deriving a score, never re-judging a finding the computation that produced it declined to call a defect, and never ruling on which side is right where a computed signal and an asserted assessment disagree.
